column2: (1) The Institute shall have its own Fund.

column1: (2) There shall be paid into the Fund of the Institute—

column2: all such sums of money as may be voted from time
to time, by Parliament for the use of the Institute;
all such sums of money as may be received by the
Institute in the exercise, and discharge of its powers
all such sums of money as may be received by the
Institute by way of donations, gifts and grants from
any source in Sri Lanka or abroad; and
all such sums of money as may be received as the
income derived from the investment of its funds.
